products.name: Whey Protein

directions: Mix 1 heaping scoop (30 g) with 150 ml water. Depending on your nutritional needs, use 2-4 servings daily.

products.name: Royal Mass
body: Royal Nutrition Royal Mass is a gainer powder combining a carbohydrate matrix and a protein matrix with L-glutamine, creatine monohydrate, HMB, L-citrulline, BCAA and B vitamins. A 100 g serving provides 30 g of protein and 48.8 g of carbohydrates.

B3), calcium D-pantothenate (vit. B5), thiamine mononitrate (vit. B1), riboflavin (vit. B2), pyridoxine hydrochloride (vit. B6)).
directions: Mix 2 heaping scoops (~ 100 g) with 300 – 400 ml water or milk and shake for 30 seconds. Take after training and as a snack if you have a high energy demand.
footnotes: *% RDA – recommended daily allowance (based on a 2,000 calorie diet)
warnings: Allergy Information Contains milk components. May contain traces of soy, egg and wheat (gluten).

Important Information: This product is a food supplement. Use this product in conjunction with food as part of a healthy, balanced diet, not as a substitute for such. Keep out of reach of children. It is intended for only 18 years of age or older. Not intended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women! Don’t exceed the recommended daily dosage.
storage: Store in a cool, dry place. Do not expose to excessive heat, moisture or sunlight. Use before the expiration date written on the pack

products.name: Glutamine Powder
body: Royal Nutrition Glutamine Powder is a pure L-glutamine dietary supplement. L-Glutamine is important for repairing and building muscle and reducing muscle catabolism (breakdown) making it a valuable aid for those undergoing heavy workouts. People who engage in intense exercise have an increased dietary requirement to restore L-glutamine levels to normal to avoid loss of muscle mass.
products.ingredients: 100% L-Glutamine powder.
directions: Take ½ scoop (4 g) mixed with 300 ml water or juice, 3 times daily.
On workout days: 1st serving in the morning after getting up, 2nd serving immediately after workout, 3rd serving at bedtime.
On non-workout days: 1st serving in the morning after getting up, 2nd serving between meals, 3rd serving at bedtime.

Creatine is a precursor to the bio-energetic fuel creatine phosphate, which replenishes cellular ATP (adenosine triphosphate) levels during maximum intensity contractions. Supplementing with creatine can increase levels of creatine phosphate in the muscle improving work output capacity, power, recovery and muscle hydration. When muscles are hydrated, muscle catabolism (breakdown) is minimized.
Creatine increases physical performance in successive bursts of short-term, high intensity exercise*.
